enum, 1 group, national: SELECT race_recoded, married AS k, SUM(perwt)::BIGINT AS wt, COUNT(*) AS n FROM '__DATA__' WHERE married >= 0 AND race_recoded >= 0 GROUP BY ALL
enum, 3 groups, filtered: SELECT sex, veteran, latino_race, citizenship AS k, SUM(perwt)::BIGINT AS wt, COUNT(*) AS n FROM '__DATA__' WHERE citizenship >= 0 AND sex >= 0 AND veteran >= 0 AND latino_race >= 0 AND race_recoded = 1 GROUP BY ALL
enum, 3 groups, CA+TX: SELECT race_recoded, sex, age_group, citizenship AS k, SUM(perwt)::BIGINT AS wt, COUNT(*) AS n FROM '__DATA__' WHERE citizenship >= 0 AND race_recoded >= 0 AND sex >= 0 AND age_group >= 0 AND statefip IN (6,48) GROUP BY ALL
enum, by state, age range: SELECT statefip, eduatt AS k, SUM(perwt)::BIGINT AS wt, COUNT(*) AS n FROM '__DATA__' WHERE eduatt >= 0 AND statefip >= 0 AND race_recoded = 1 AND age >= 25 AND age <= 64 GROUP BY ALL
enum, county filter, 2 groups: SELECT race_recoded, sex, coverage_type AS k, SUM(perwt)::BIGINT AS wt, COUNT(*) AS n FROM '__DATA__' WHERE coverage_type >= 0 AND race_recoded >= 0 AND sex >= 0 AND county_id IN (6037) GROUP BY ALL
enum, many filters: SELECT race_recoded, age_group, ownership AS k, SUM(perwt)::BIGINT AS wt, COUNT(*) AS n FROM '__DATA__' WHERE ownership >= 0 AND race_recoded >= 0 AND age_group >= 0 AND citizenship IN (1,2) AND eduatt_condensed IN (2,3) AND sex IN (2) AND hhincome >= 50000 AND hhincome <= 150000 GROUP BY ALL
mean, national: SELECT race_recoded, SUM(household_size*hhwt)/SUM(hhwt) AS household_size_mean, SUM(hhwt)::BIGINT AS household_size_total, COUNT(*) AS household_size_n FROM '__DATA__' WHERE household_size >= 0 AND race_recoded >= 0 GROUP BY race_recoded
median age, national:
WITH h AS (SELECT race_recoded, age AS v, SUM(perwt) AS wt, COUNT(*) AS n FROM '__DATA__' WHERE age >= 0 AND race_recoded >= 0 GROUP BY ALL),
c AS (SELECT *, SUM(wt) OVER (PARTITION BY race_recoded ORDER BY v ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cw, SUM(wt) OVER (PARTITION BY race_recoded) AS tw, SUM(n) OVER (PARTITION BY race_recoded) AS tn FROM h)
SELECT race_recoded, MIN(v) FILTER (WHERE cw >= tw/2.0) AS age_median, ANY_VALUE(tw)::BIGINT AS age_total, ANY_VALUE(tn) AS age_n FROM c GROUP BY race_recoded
median hhincome, CA, 2 groups:
WITH h AS (SELECT race_recoded, sex, hhincome AS v, SUM(hhwt) AS wt, COUNT(*) AS n FROM '__DATA__' WHERE hhincome >= 0 AND race_recoded >= 0 AND sex >= 0 AND statefip = 6 GROUP BY ALL),
c AS (SELECT *, SUM(wt) OVER (PARTITION BY race_recoded, sex ORDER BY v ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cw, SUM(wt) OVER (PARTITION BY race_recoded, sex) AS tw, SUM(n) OVER (PARTITION BY race_recoded, sex) AS tn FROM h)
SELECT race_recoded, sex, MIN(v) FILTER (WHERE cw >= tw/2.0) AS hhincome_median, ANY_VALUE(tw)::BIGINT AS hhincome_total, ANY_VALUE(tn) AS hhincome_n FROM c GROUP BY race_recoded, sex
median wage, by state:
WITH h AS (SELECT statefip, wage AS v, SUM(perwt) AS wt, COUNT(*) AS n FROM '__DATA__' WHERE wage >= 0 AND statefip >= 0 AND race_recoded = 1 GROUP BY ALL),
c AS (SELECT *, SUM(wt) OVER (PARTITION BY statefip ORDER BY v ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cw, SUM(wt) OVER (PARTITION BY statefip) AS tw, SUM(n) OVER (PARTITION BY statefip) AS tn FROM h)
SELECT statefip, MIN(v) FILTER (WHERE cw >= tw/2.0) AS wage_median, ANY_VALUE(tw)::BIGINT AS wage_total, ANY_VALUE(tn) AS wage_n FROM c GROUP BY statefip
latino_origin_detailed, by state: SELECT statefip, latino_origin_detailed AS k, SUM(perwt)::BIGINT AS wt, COUNT(*) AS n FROM '__DATA__' WHERE latino_origin_detailed >= 0 AND statefip >= 0 AND race_recoded = 1 GROUP BY ALL
